# @younndai/yon-examples

> YON v2.0 cookbook — 59 runnable examples across 13 categories covering all 72 spec tags.

## Install

```bash
npm install @younndai/yon-examples
```

## Core Capabilities

- **59 hand-authored examples** — covering L1–L2 Core, L3 Cognition, L4 Agents
- **13 categories** — getting-started through change-control
- **72/72 spec tag coverage** — every YON v2.0 tag demonstrated
- **Auto-discovery** — examples found by convention, no registration
- **CLI** — browse, search, and display examples from terminal
- **Programmatic API** — `discoverExamples()`, `findExample()`, `readExample()`, `getCategories()`

## Quick Start

```ts
import { discoverExamples, findExample, readExample } from '@younndai/yon-examples';

const all = discoverExamples();
const kyc = findExample('fintech-kyc');
if (kyc) console.log(readExample(kyc));
```

## CLI

```bash
npx yon-examples list                        # List all examples
npx yon-examples show hello-world            # View an example
npx yon-examples list --category 08-domains  # Filter by category
npx yon-examples categories                  # List categories
```

## Categories

| Category | Coverage |
|----------|----------|
| 01-getting-started | Config, intent, schema, pipelines |
| 02-data-engineering | ETL, transforms, streaming yield |
| 03-control-flow | Conditionals, loops, parallelism |
| 04-resilience | Retry, circuit-breaker, sessions, recovery |
| 05-devops | CI pipelines, health checks |
| 06-advanced | Plugins, sub-workflows, streams |
| 07-declarative | Rules, specs, notes |
| 08-domains | 15 industry-specific workflows |
| 09-showcase | Cognitive + Agent profile demos |
| 10-cognition | L3 reasoning, memory, perception, affect |
| 11-agents | L4 signaling, governance, collaboration |
| 12-privacy | Consent, redaction, classification |
| 13-change-control | Patches, voids, versioned edits |

## Testing

```bash
npm test
```

All `.yon` files are auto-discovered and parsed. 60 tests validate parsing integrity.
